item.text: {"search_note":"I found no strong 2024 evidence of explicit personality cult directives, formal loyalty tests, or a clearly documented party-capture of legislatures or audit bodies. The evidence base is much stronger on security-force intimidation, cybercrime prosecutions, and pressure on journalists than on classic party-machine capture. So the best reading is not “proved cult/party capture,” but rather some reformist/administrative signals alongside a broader pattern of intimidation and politicized enforcement.","evidence":[{"title":"Posts mislead about ethnic links of new intelligence chiefs appointed by Nigerian president","publisher":"AFP Fact Check","date":"2024-09-04","url":"https://factcheck.afp.com/doc.afp.com.36FF4M8","summary":"AFP said social-media claims that Tinubu installed a Yoruba-only intelligence leadership were misleading; one appointee was Nupe, and the other was Yoruba. This is the clearest positive evidence for decentralization and against pure central political control, though it remains policy-level rhetoric.","question_ids":["4B.5","4B.4","3B.4"]},{"title":"President Tinubu appoints new leadership for Police Service Commission and Nigerian Police Trust Fund","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-06-10","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-new-leadership-for-police-service-commission-and-nigerian-police-trust-fund/","summary":"Tinubu appointed new leadership for bodies that support police oversight and financing. This is modestly positive because it can strengthen civilian supervision capacity, but the release does not show these institutions were empowered to constrain the presidency.","question_ids":["4B.5","4B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria’s Tinubu names seven ministers, sacks five in cabinet reshuffle","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-10-23","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigerias-tinubu-names-seven-ministers-sacks-five-in-cabinet-reshuffle/2325625/","summary":"Reuters reported a cabinet reshuffle in which Tinubu sacked five ministers, swapped ten, and retained several key portfolios. That is mixed evidence: the dialogue line is restraint, but the parallel coercive posture undercuts any clean claim of avoiding intimidation.","question_ids":["4B.5","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Nigerian police tear gas protesters, arrest dozens","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-08-03","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigerian-police-teargas-protesters-arrest-dozens/2206531/","summary":"Police used tear gas and arrests to disperse protesters and keep demonstrations away from government offices. This is negative evidence for intimidation and for treating dissent as a threat to be managed politically.","question_ids":["4B.5","4B.3","3B.8","3B.9"]}]}
